rationale: This draft offers a different supported family: one-hot QUBO pivot optimization. It describes desired lexicographic magnitude/index ordering and a sufficient penalty as obligations but does not supply an objective, coefficient map or proven bound; nonfinite-state encoding is explicitly unresolved. The frozen checker interprets concrete Boolean pivot predicates or ordered comparison scans, not an unspecified QUBO. Translating the stated optimization goal into a reviewer-invented predicate or choosing coefficients would complete the model's missing construction. Keep insufficient evidence and retain the family change as a coverage observation; do not call the alternative family incorrect, passed, withdrawn or repaired. Verification/fallback and the full hybrid plan remain unexecuted.
